children: Twilio uses webhooks to notify third-party apps of events in its main products including voice calls initiated, SMS messages sent, and dialogs started in autopilot. You can wire Twilio events to trigger action in third-party apps such as record when someone responds to an SMS message.

content.name: p
children: Unlike most providers, Twilio doesn't sign the raw request body. It signs the full URL Twilio requested plus the
parameters, which means the URL your code reconstructs must match the one Twilio called exactly — including scheme, host, port, and query string.
